in_arabic.name: عيوشة
in_arabic.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'ayy' meaning 'life' and 'sha' meaning 'giving', 'reviving'. It is believed to be a name of Allah Almighty, signifying His ability to give and revive life.

in_urdu.name: عائوشہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: A name name of Arabic origin, meaning 'abode of life'. In Urdu, it is translated as 'hayat daar', which means 'dwelling of life'.

in_hindi.name: आयूषा
in_hindi.long_meaning: A name of Arabic origin, translated into Hindi as 'jeevan', which means 'life'.

in_pashto.name: عيوشه
in_pashto.long_meaning: A name of Arabic origin, translated into Pashto as 'nafsunka', which means 'belonging to self' or 'soul'.
